name: Shadow Boxing
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your hands guarding your face and knees slightly bent. Throw combinations of punches into the open air, such as jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts.
Incorporate head movement and footwork between combinations, pivoting and stepping as if evading and closing distance on an imaginary opponent.
Shadow boxing builds punching technique, coordination, and cardiovascular endurance without any equipment. A 150 lb person will burn around 300 calories shadow boxing for 30 minutes.
